inputs.text: Provisional visual concept only for Jayze, an original articulated action figure in the anime-action-hero mold. One heroic humanoid toy with visible ball-jointed shoulders, elbows, hips and knees, molded-plastic panels, a sheathed short blade on the back, confident ready stance, no armor plating. Warm gold and deep teal panels are a temporary color study, not approved canon. Three-quarter front view, entire figure centered and isolated against a plain white studio background, soft product photography lighting, crisp silhouette, realistic small toy materials, no people, no scenery, no text, no logos, no watermark, no extra figures.
